visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a large pink bow sits in a brightly lit restaurant. She wears a white fuzzy cardigan over a pink checkered dress. She uses chopsticks to pick up food from a bubbling hotpot on a portable burner. (2) Two square yellow and purple containers of cat food are shown in a close-up against a plain background. The label "Les repas Plaisir" is clearly visible with cat imagery. (3) The woman is shown again, holding the cat food containers and smiling brightly with one finger raised. She then uses a small silver spoon to feed a white cat wearing a lace collar. (4) Various clips show the woman interacting with the white cat: petting it on a wooden platform, carrying it in her arms, and kissing its head in a cozy indoor setting with posters on the wall. (5) The woman, now in her pink checkered dress without the cardigan, pulls a pink rolling pet carrier through a modern interior space, waving to the camera.
